title: Valorant Defuse
blurb: Sweetest sound in Valorant, and it lasts about a second. The defuse completion cue arrives at the end of a seven-second window that usually involves somebody being shot at, so it functions less as a notification than as a release. The round is over, the Spike is dead, and whoever was holding that angle can finally breathe out. Half-defusing and backing off is a tense sub-game of its own, which leaves the completed version even better earned. Use it whenever a crisis has, quite literally, just been defused.
origin: The Spike defuse completion sound from Valorant (Riot Games).
